title: Find where emails are registered
description: Check one or many emails across 120+ sites and see where each is registered. Add several to check them all in one bulk run.

emails.title: Emails
emails.description: The email addresses to check. Add one, or paste many to check them all in one run (up to 100). We clean and de-duplicate them, and skip anything that is not a valid address.

onlyUsed.title: Only show sites where the email is registered
onlyUsed.description: On by default. Turn this off to also record the sites where the email was not found.
onlyUsed.sectionDescription: The defaults work for most runs - you can leave this section alone.

noPasswordRecovery.title: Skip password-recovery checks
noPasswordRecovery.description: Skip the few sites that detect an account via password recovery (Adobe, Mail.ru, Odnoklassniki, Samsung). Slightly faster, slightly less coverage.

timeout.title: Per-site time limit (seconds)
timeout.description: How long to wait for each site before moving on. Default 30.

email.title: Single email (optional, legacy)
email.description: Optional single email, kept for older integrations. You can use the Emails field above instead.
